title: Opening-print bloc transfer (US-anchored release order, opening follower's deviation applied to the follower economies' pairs, vintaged first prints, PIT-gated month-closed entry, daily 16:00-NY grid)

blindness_declaration.statement: Written with ZERO outcome exposure: no scored/PnL/smoke/novelty numbers for this cycle were read; no backtest executed. Only timing, availability, coverage and count evidence from the pinned P0 census, the P1 spot grid census and the family-failure inventory was consumed; all order-state counts above were measured from publication instants only (never from print values).

mechanism.story: In each US-anchored month the opening follower's print is the bloc's FIRST same-coverage cross-check of the US anchor - the only non-US datapoint in the early window. Because the non-US economies share a large common inflation component, the opening print's deviation is a LEADING statistic for the follower economies whose same-coverage prints have not yet published (or have just published and not yet been processed by slow money). Slow periodic participants - benchmark rebalancers and corporate hedgers on monthly dealing cycles - implement BLOC inflation views across the non-USD pairs as a basket, after the month's print set completes; that completion window is exactly when this lane's evidenced vintaged availability makes the opening deviation provably observable. The claim: the opener's deviation sign transfers to the FOLLOWER pairs in the late window, and the ORDER (who provably opened) determines whose information is the source and whose pairs are the destinations.
mechanism.forced_or_late_participant: Forced/late participants: (i) monthly dealing-cycle real-money accounts implement bloc inflation updates only after the month's print set completes and only at scheduled windows - structurally late relative to the intra-month release sequence; (ii) THIS LANE ITSELF is a declared late participant: entry requires the opener's evidenced vintaged availability (median 24 days post-publication for GB/CA/NZ) AND month-order closure (measured: binds in 1 of 50 months; measured entry median 28 days, max 121 days after the opening print's publication). The hypothesis is specifically that a measurable fraction of the opener-keyed bloc repricing SURVIVES that lag plus the holding horizon, after costs.
mechanism.why_it_might_exist: Cross-economy CPI correlation is common knowledge, but the SEQUENCE through which the month's common component is revealed is not traded efficiently at the slow horizon: the follower economies' pairs receive the opener's information only through the slow basket implementation of periodic participants, days-to-weeks after both prints. The edge source is the order-structured INFORMATION TRANSFER (opener -> followers), NOT the sign of any release at publication (V7 closed exactly that on non-reporting pairs) and NOT any level (V8/V9 laws).
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: It must fail (after-cost per-trade expectancy <= 0) if follower pairs' late windows do not carry the opener's sign. It must die by falsification if the SAME cross-economy transfer fired WITHOUT order-state (the mandatory V7-ancestry control: every non-US print's sign applied to every other non-US economy's pair, both directions) reproduces the anchor - then the order structure carries nothing and the book is V7's spillover class re-clocked; if a nominal-yield-level exposure reproduces it (V8 law); if a constant-direction calendar shadow reproduces it (Q-7); if a sign-permuted opener book reproduces it (placebo); or at D2 if pooled ancestry |rho| > 0.20 (accepted in advance).

information_source_and_surprise_construc.information_source: (a) evidenced monthly print PUBLICATION ORDER from the pinned announcement census (census sha256 e8a35d23ce64ce71a8d30792750b877c387de3692af1e4d17391ea4cc35b4abe, re-measured at this checkout); (b) realized vintaged CPI first-print index levels of the OPENING economy vs a frozen seasonal-naive predictor. The follower prints' own realized values are NEVER read for the signal. NO consensus/forecast data anywhere (plan section 9).

order_construction.month_grouping: calendar month of the evidenced (local) publication date - the release-calendar month; all prints of a month cover the same inflation window: GB/CA monthly prints cover reference month M-1, AU/NZ quarterly prints cover the quarter ENDING M-1 (census reference_period label = the quarter's first month)
order_construction.interval_order_rule: ordering uses P-1-evidenced publication instants ONLY: exact-time instants (CA 12:30Z, NZ Auckland 10:45 DST-corrected) are points; DATE_ONLY evidence (GB, AU, US) is a full-day uncertainty interval [00:00Z, 23:59:59Z]; X strictly-precedes Y iff X's latest possible instant < Y's earliest possible instant; anything else is UNPROVABLE ORDER and fails closed
order_construction.us_anchored_month: a month is US-ANCHORED iff the US same-coverage print strictly precedes EVERY non-US print of that month under the interval rule; non-anchored months are excluded (no state)
order_construction.opening_follower: the OPENING FOLLOWER (OF) is the unique non-US print that strictly precedes every other non-US print of a US-anchored month; the FOLLOWERS are all other non-US prints of that month (each provably after the OF by construction); months without a provable unique OF are NO-STATE and excluded (fail-closed)

measured_order_census.non_anchored_detail: 2 months with a CA print before the US print (2018-10, 2019-03); 6 months with a GB print tying the US date (date-only evidence both sides, order unprovable)
measured_order_census.AU_note: AU never opens (publishes day 25-31); AU appears only as a FOLLOWER pair destination
measured_order_census.no_unique_OF_cause: CA exact-time instants fall INSIDE GB date-only windows (same local date) - order unprovable, fail-closed
measured_order_census.binary_vs_US_degeneracy_disclosed: the naive binary 'non-US prints before US' clock is measured DEGENERATE (2 events in 7 years); the viable order structure is the post-US release sequence, of which this proposal trades the opener -> follower transfer

information_source_and_surprise_construc.predictor: I_hat_sn(m) = I(m-1) * ( I(m-12) / I(m-13) ), where I(k) is the vintaged index level for month k of the OPENING economy in the vintage in force at the decision instant (point-in-time read, never a later revision).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.predictor_name: seasonal-naive one-step (last-year same-month seasonal ratio applied to the latest vintaged level), opener economy only
information_source_and_surprise_construc.surprise: s1_OF = 100 * ( I_print(m) / I_hat_sn(m) - 1 ), in percentage points of index deviation, of the OPENING print only; the single gate for ALL of that month's follower-pair positions.
information_source_and_surprise_construc.i_print_source: vintaged_first_value of the pinned census first-release instant of the opening print.
information_source_and_surprise_construc.pit_rule: All predictor inputs I(m-1), I(m-12), I(m-13) are read as-of the decision instant (the vintage in force then); I_print is the first-release vintaged value; the order state (US-anchored + unique OF + follower set) is determined exclusively by publication-instant evidence, and the entry clock additionally requires month-order closure (every follower print published) so the full month order is PIT-closed before entry; no value that entered its vintage after the decision instant may be read (P-1..P-6 chain; ONE_EVENT_LAG impossible by construction).

frozen_parameters.neighbour_parameterization: information-source parameterization: trailing-YoY deviation of the opener, s2_OF = 100 * ( I_print(m) / ( I(m-12) * (1 + pi_bar(m)) ) - 1 ) with pi_bar(m) = I(m-1)/I(m-13) - 1 (identical formula class as lane A4-P2, frozen independently here); gate |s2_OF| >= 0.15 pp, same transfer construction, same H = 5
frozen_parameters.threshold_selection_basis: blind frozen priors chosen before any outcome; no tuning permitted after any number is seen (P-15)

GB.quoting: CCY/USD, long = long GBP vs USD

CA.quoting: USD/CAD, long = long USD vs CAD, therefore long CAD = short USDCAD

AU.quoting: CCY/USD, long = long AUD vs USD

NZ.quoting: CCY/USD, long = long NZD vs USD

US.quoting: the US print generates NO position in this lane - it is the anchor/state variable only

universe.event_instrument_law: each event is (opener month) x (follower economy): positions fire on the FOLLOWER economies' pairs only (follower GB -> GBPUSD, follower CA -> USDCAD, follower AU -> AUDUSD, follower NZ -> NZDUSD); the opener's OWN pair NEVER fires in this proposal (that is A5-P1's construction, distinct by design); US print generates no position.
universe.direction_law: s1_OF >= +0.10 => long the FOLLOWER currency vs USD for every follower pair of that month (GB: long GBPUSD; CA: short USDCAD; AU: long AUDUSD; NZ: long NZDUSD). s1_OF <= -0.10 => the mirror on every follower pair. |s1_OF| < 0.10 => no position anywhere that month. All of a month's follower positions fire or skip TOGETHER on the single opener gate; 1 unit each. Two-sided by construction: no static currency or dollar bias.

warmup.requirement: vintaged index history of at least 13 months of the OPENING economy before its reference month (I(m-1), I(m-12), I(m-13) must exist in the vintage in force at the decision instant); the neighbour's s2 source needs the same 13 months; no expanding-window normalization anywhere in this proposal; follower economies' index histories are NOT required by the signal
warmup.structural_status: satisfied: vintaged feeds start 1948-1955, far before the 2018-04 S0 start; warmup is a per-event data-window rule, not a burn-in period

features: s1_OF (opener deviation) is the ONLY signal feature; the order state (US-anchored + unique opener + follower set) is a conditioning clock on WHICH pairs may receive the transfer, never a priced feature
features_and_lags.lags: vintaged index months m-1, m-12, m-13 of the opener economy relative to reference month m
features_and_lags.explicit_non_features: no follower-print deviation enters the signal in any form (the transfer IS the claim - conditioning on follower deviations would be a different family); no consensus/forecast data (no authority exists); no nominal yield level in the signal (yield level appears ONLY inside the mandatory control arm); no entry on the opener's own pair (A5-P1's construction)

entry_exit_fills.entry: at the D(e) 16:00-NY grid price of each follower pair's staged spot series (declared dependency), iff |s1_OF| >= 0.10 pp at that instant; 1 unit notional per follower pair; all of a month's follower positions enter at the same grid instant
entry_exit_fills.exit: at the grid instant H = 5 grid days after entry (next grid day if that instant is not a trading day); forced exit at the 2025-04-30 grid instant for positions whose horizon extends past window end (declared tail convention); months whose D(e) falls after the window end cannot enter and are dropped (measured: 3 of 89 pair-decisions)
entry_exit_fills.fills: entry fill and exit fill each executed once at grid prices; positions from different months are held independently (no netting), each exiting at its own horizon
entry_exit_fills.no_lookback_guards: signals computed only from information PIT-available at D(e); the frozen validator refuses any fill whose conditioning value OR conditioning publication instant postdates the decision instant (month-order closure makes the follower-set identity provably known at entry)

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A5-P2-CTL-V7RECAP
arm_battery.config: MANDATORY (plan section 6 lane A5): the identical cross-economy transfer form WITHOUT any order-state: for EVERY non-US first-release event X of the 77 US-anchored months (opener, co-earliest ties and later followers alike), apply sign(s1_X) (own |s1_X| >= 0.10 gate) to the pairs of EVERY OTHER non-US economy printing in the same month - BOTH directions X->Y and Y->X (390 pair-decisions measured) - each at its own month-closed entry clock, H = 5, 1 unit per pair-decision

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A5-P2-CTL-DGS10LEVEL
arm_battery.config: identical fired anchor book (same event days, follower pairs, horizons, 1-unit magnitudes), but direction carries ONLY a nominal-yield-level exposure with print conditioning removed: sign = +1 (long the follower currency vs USD) iff the DGS10 level as-of D(e) (vintaged S2) is below its trailing 252-grid-day median, else -1
arm_battery.role: V8 LAW MANDATE: if this control reproduces the anchor (same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x), the transfer book is a nominal-yield-level exposure in new words => dead (falsification-by-control cluster #14 law)

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A5-P2-SHADOW-CLOCK
arm_battery.config: identical fired anchor book, direction = constant +1 (always long the follower currency vs USD); zero information content
arm_battery.role: Q-7 clock-only shadow: isolates pure calendar-clock + static-drift exposure on the follower-pair basket; reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x) => the clock explains it => dead

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A5-P2-PLACEBO-ORDPERM

ancestry_defense.v7_reaction_direction_closed_SPECIFIC: FOREX-FREE-V7 closed the reaction-direction class 'on both sides of the economy boundary', and this proposal is the closest living relative of that closure: FXFV7-A4-P1 was CROSS-ECONOMY RELEASE-SIGN SPILLOVER on non-reporting pairs, entering at publication, and died mechanically AND by falsification-by-control cluster #12 (the +7d sham reproduced the anchor). This lane differs STRUCTURALLY on four axes: (i) ENTRY is PIT-late (measured median 28 days after the opening print, month-order closed) - V7 entered at publication on a 4/9-grid clock; (ii) the SIGN SOURCE is a magnitude-bearing naive-predictor deviation (no consensus data exists to be a 'release surprise' here); (iii) the INSTRUMENT SET is order-structured: only follower pairs of a provably-unique opening print, never all non-reporting pairs; (iv) the MANDATORY CTL-V7RECAP runs the unordered both-directions transfer (the V7 form re-clocked to this entry) on the identical clock - kill at >= 0.5x same-sign per-trade, accepted in advance. FXFV7-A6-P2 (EURUSD lead-lag diffusion) additionally died with its own-lag control OUT-earning it - the reason this proposal's control battery keeps the transfer form itself under the no-order control rather than trusting the rho gate alone. D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the full inventory (both V7 books included) applies; over the bar => D2 VETO.
ancestry_defense.v8_nominal_level_law: V8 falsification-by-control #14 made a nominal-exposure control MANDATORY on every yield/inflation lane. Carried as CTL-DGS10LEVEL on the identical follower-pair clock; no nominal yield level enters the signal. If the control reproduces the anchor, the family is dead by law.
ancestry_defense.v9_ppp_vetoes: V9 A5-P1/P2 died as PPP/real-rate LEVEL-misalignment books (rho 0.3034/0.3119 vs the V8 anchor). This proposal carries no PPP, real-rate, or level-misalignment state anywhere; conditioning is event-time order structure, two-sided, deviation-gated. D2 rho gate vs the V9 veto books applies.
ancestry_defense.v5_sham_calendar_standard: order-state placebo carried (PLACEBO-ORDPERM), the V5-era house standard adapted to the order axis: book and sign marginals preserved exactly, order alignment destroyed.
ancestry_defense.v3_pit_chain: P-1..P-6 incident chain honored: interval-aware ordering asserts 'before' ONLY when provable (date-only evidence = full-day uncertainty; same-date exact-vs-date-only = fail-closed), conservative end-of-day availability bounds, month-order closure at entry, as-of vintage reads, fill validator refuses any conditioning instant or value that postdates the decision.
ancestry_defense.v9_high_finding_binding: non-US legs come ONLY from the vintaged channel (pinned sha256s above); current-vintage revised-in-place tables are FORBIDDEN for GB/CA legs (and all non-US legs).

R2 V7_ANCESTRY (MANDATORY, lane-specific): CTL-V7RECAP same-sign per-trade expectancy >= 0.5x anchor => the order structure carries nothing; the transfer is V7's cross-economy spillover class re-clocked onto the PIT-late naive-deviation entry => dead + D2 VETO recorded (this is the plan section 6 lane-A5 closure test)

expected_failure_interpretation.R1_with_clean_controls: follower pairs' late windows do not carry the opener's sign after costs: cross-economy information transfer at the monthly print-sequence level does not survive to the PIT-provable horizon. CONSISTENT WITH (not contradicting) the V7 closure - V7 closed publication-instant spillover; a null here licenses NO claim about that horizon.
expected_failure_interpretation.R2_fires: the anchor is the V7 spillover book wearing an order mask; the lane-level closure re-fires exactly as the plan mandated. The most likely failure mode of this family and the reason the control is lane-mandatory.
expected_failure_interpretation.R3_fires: the transfer book is a nominal-yield-level exposure in new words; the V8 law re-fires on the order lane exactly as designed.
expected_failure_interpretation.R4_fires: calendar-frequency drift on the follower-pair basket, not order information.
expected_failure_interpretation.R5_fires: the fixed follower basket and its sign marginals explain it; which month's opener carried the information is irrelevant.
expected_failure_interpretation.R6_fires: the seasonal-naive source is not mechanism-bearing (the acceleration form is, or neither is); the family still dies (no rescue by re-ranking arms).
